en: A black‑and‑white postcard view of a forested valley with railway tracks in the foreground leading towards a large stone railway viaduct with multiple arches in the distance. Evergreen trees frame the scene on both sides, and telegraph poles run along the tracks. At the top of the card, in red Gothic-style script, is German text identifying the location near Oederan and Hetzdorf.
